title: Cavaliers @ Wizards — Tre Johnson made free throw recorded as a miss, final score corrected 148-114 to 148-115 (Nov 7-8, 2025)
incident_summary: With 8:15 remaining in the second quarter, Wizards rookie Tre Johnson shot two free throws and made both, but the first attempt was incorrectly entered as a miss. The game ended with an announced final of Cavaliers 148, Wizards 114. The next morning (Nov 8, 2025), the NBA acknowledged the error in a statement and updated the official final score to Cavaliers 148, Wizards 115 — a one-point correction that changed the combined total from 262 to 263. Johnson's line was updated to 19 points on 2-of-3 free throws.
scoring_play: Tre Johnson (WAS) first free throw attempt of a two-shot sequence — made, but entered as missed. He made both attempts.
score_before: Cavaliers led 50-39 at the time (per Bleacher Report, secondary — not confirmed by other outlets in this pass)

originally_reported.basis: Announced final at end of game Nov 7, 2025, before correction (The Athletic, Bleacher Report, HoopsWire).

corrected_value.basis: NBA statement Nov 8, 2025 as quoted by multiple outlets: Johnson's first FT 'was incorrectly entered as a missed free throw, when in fact he made both' and 'game statistics have been corrected.'

final_official.basis: Corrected official final per The Athletic, Bleacher Report, HoopsWire, Nov 8-9, 2025.

sources_disagreed: In-arena stat crew game-night entry (first FT missed) vs. corrected league record (both made)
Secondary outlets briefly carried the 148-114 final before updating to 148-115

cause.detail: Human error by the in-arena statistician, who missed the made free throw. NBA SVP of league-operations communications Tim Frank told The Athletic it was 'just a case of human error' and 'not something that happens a lot'; the league's stats auditors missed it in real time and caught it in the full post-game review.

timeline.event: Cavaliers @ Wizards in D.C.; Johnson's made first free throw with 8:15 left in Q2 is entered as a miss and the scoreboard does not move. Game ends announced as 148-114 Cavaliers.
NBA issues a statement acknowledging the error and the game statistics are corrected to a 148-115 final. Johnson's line becomes 19 points, 2-of-3 FTs.
